entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: Second in command to Jodah at the School of the Unseen who staged a coup and later led the school's remnant east.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage of the School of the Unseen at Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Royal mage of Kjeldor and Gerda's cousin; co-conspirator.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer to whom Jodah was handed over.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Jodah's old friend who freed him and later became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's malevolent spirit tracked by Jodah.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: School at Lat-Nam, destroyed by war beasts.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: Battle in which Kjeldor and Balduvia defeated Lim-Dûl's hordes.

entities.name: Fall of the School of the Unseen
entities.description: Swift destruction of the school by Soldevi Steam Beasts and Phyrexian War Beasts.

events.summary: Envious of Jodah, Gerda and Gustha kidnap him while his memories are stored and give him to Lim-Dûl; Gerda becomes Magus of the Unseen.
events.quote: Thus, Gerda became the Magus of the Unseen.

events.summary: Jaya frees Jodah and they help defeat Lim-Dûl's hordes.
events.quote: After Jodah's old friend Jaya Ballard freed him from Tresserhorn

events.summary: Jodah resumes control and reprimands Gerda but lets her remain second-in-command.
War beasts attack the School; Gerda destroys one but cannot save it, and Jaya stops the fall.
events.quote: The Fall of the School of the Unseen was swift

events.summary: Gerda and Ozmar leave Lat-Nam; Jodah grants her the position of Archmage; they sail east.
events.quote: she was legally granted the position of Archmage of the Unseen by Jodah

relations.quote: second in command to archmage Jodah
Gerda staged a coup with Gustha Ebbasdotter
